tools.name: postalform.list_forms
tools.description: Use this when you need the published single-mailpiece PostalForm workflow catalog available to agents. Coordinated statutory multi-recipient workflows are excluded.

tools.name: postalform.get_form_schema
tools.description: Use this when you need a machine-usable schema for one supported single-mailpiece PostalForm workflow (fields, groups, attachments, and dependencies).

tools.name: postalform.search_addresses
tools.description: Use this to search for a mailing address and return Loqate suggestions with IDs. Pass country_code to filter by country; it defaults to US. If a suggestion has type "Container" (building/complex), call this tool again with container=<id> and a refined query to drill down to type "Address". Only type "Address" is valid for order creation.

target.description: Which address field is being searched (used for UI context).

query.description: Partial address text, e.g. "123 Main St"

country_code.description: Two-letter country code to filter suggestions. Defaults to US.

container.description: Loqate container id for drilling into suggestions, if provided

tools.name: postalform.create_pdf_upload
tools.description: Use this when the host cannot provide a PDF file param directly. It creates a short-lived PDF upload URL and upload token (multipart/form-data, file field). Let the HTTP client generate Content-Type with its multipart boundary.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse the same value if retrying the call.

tools.name: postalform.create_order_draft
tools.description: Prepare an existing PDF for mailing and return the order ID, total, hosted checkout URL, and checkout session. After buyer approval, a compatible client can pass a Stripe shared payment token to complete_checkout; otherwise present the hosted checkout URL. To prepare for MPP, set payment_protocol=mpp and buyer_email; receive a PDF preview, hosted checkout_url fallback and MPP challenge, then use postalform.pay_order with the order_id after buyer approval. Draft creation never pays. For x402, use postalform.create_machine_order.

payment_protocol.description: Optional payment path. Defaults to hosted checkout. Choose mpp to return a payment challenge for this same prepared order; buyer_email is required. Draft creation never pays.

buyer_name.description: Receipt name; defaults to sender_name for MPP.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Reuse the same value if retrying the call.

pdf.description: The PDF to mail. Accepts attachment objects ({ download_url, file_id }). Fallbacks: upload_token from postalform.create_pdf_upload, data:application/pdf;base64,..., or a public HTTPS download URL.

sender_address_id.description: Loqate address id for the sender (required when sender_address_type is Address).

sender_address_type.description: Address suggestion type for the sender (from postalform.search_addresses). Use Manual to pass a structured address with countryCode when outside the US.

sender_address_text.description: Human-readable sender address preview (required when sender_address_type is Address; optional for Manual).

sender_address_manual.description: Sender manual address fields (required when sender_address_type is Manual).

sender_company.description: Optional company, department or attention line printed under sender_name in the return address (at most 40 characters).

recipient_company.description: Optional company, department or attention line printed under recipient_name, for example "Acme Corp, ATTN: Legal" (at most 40 characters).

recipient_address_id.description: Loqate address id for the recipient (required when recipient_address_type is Address).

recipient_address_type.description: Address suggestion type for the recipient (from postalform.search_addresses). Use Manual to pass a structured address with countryCode when outside the US.

recipient_address_text.description: Human-readable recipient address preview (required when recipient_address_type is Address; optional for Manual).

recipient_address_manual.description: Recipient manual address fields (required when recipient_address_type is Manual).

color.description: Whether to print in color (default: false).

certified.description: Whether to add proof mail: USPS Certified Mail for US destinations, Canada Post Registered Mail through PostGrid for Canadian destinations, or PinGen registered mail for supported European destinations (default: false).

certified_return_receipt.description: Add Electronic Return Receipt for US Certified Mail. Ignored for Canada Post Registered Mail and PinGen registered-mail destinations (default: false).

tools.name: postalform.preview_letter_order_draft
tools.description: Use this to prepare a non-writing preview for a mailed letter before creating checkout. It renders the letter, validates the addresses, and returns a widget with a create-draft action.

tools.name: postalform.create_letter_order_draft
tools.description: Prepare letter text for mailing and return the order ID, total, hosted checkout URL, and checkout session. Accepts text directly; no PDF upload or browser is needed. Letter drafts may include typed or drawn signatures. After buyer approval, a compatible client can use complete_checkout with a Stripe shared payment token; otherwise present the hosted checkout URL. To prepare for MPP, set payment_protocol=mpp and buyer_email; receive a PDF preview, hosted checkout_url fallback and MPP challenge, then use postalform.pay_order with the order_id after buyer approval. Draft creation never pays. For x402, use postalform.create_machine_order.

payment_protocol.description: Optional payment path. Defaults to hosted checkout. Choose mpp to return a payment challenge for this same prepared order; buyer_email is required. Draft creation never pays.

buyer_name.description: Receipt name; defaults to sender_name for MPP.

tools.name: postalform.create_form_order_draft
tools.description: Prepare a supported workflow form for mailing and return the order ID, total, hosted checkout URL, and checkout session. After buyer approval, a compatible client can use complete_checkout with a Stripe shared payment token; otherwise present the hosted checkout URL. To prepare for MPP, set payment_protocol=mpp and buyer_email; receive a PDF preview, hosted checkout_url fallback and MPP challenge, then use postalform.pay_order with the order_id after buyer approval. Draft creation never pays. For x402, use postalform.create_machine_order.

payment_protocol.description: Optional payment path. Defaults to hosted checkout. Choose mpp to return a payment challenge for this same prepared order; buyer_email is required. Draft creation never pays.

buyer_name.description: Receipt name; defaults to sender_name for MPP.

use_workflow_recipient.description: Deprecated compatibility field. Predefined and computed workflow recipients are always enforced and cannot be overridden.

tools.name: postalform.create_machine_order
tools.description: Create a single PDF, letter, workflow-form order, or bulk letter campaign and pay through MPP or x402 after buyer approval. For bulk, provide exactly one of bulk.csv_content or bulk.recipients (JSON address objects with optional merge_fields), plus a shared PDF or text/HTML template. Omit top-level recipient fields and review campaign_url, recipient count and total. Bulk MPP orders can also use postalform.pay_order after fetching its challenge. The unpaid response also includes checkout_url and status_url for this same order. Without an available compatible wallet, give the buyer checkout_url and poll status_url; never recreate the order to change payment paths. Single-recipient clients with a Stripe shared payment token can instead use a draft tool followed by complete_checkout; other clients should present the hosted checkout URL.

payment_protocol.description: Direct machine payment protocol. Use mpp for Link CLI/Link MCP or Stripe SPT; use x402 for x402 wallet clients. Defaults to mpp.

request_id.description: Idempotency key. Reuse the same value and same order fields after a payment challenge.

pdf.description: Existing PDF to mail. For a single recipient, provide exactly one of pdf, letter, or form. For bulk.content_mode=pdf, this PDF is sent to every CSV or JSON recipient. Prefer upload_token from postalform.create_pdf_upload.

letter.description: Letter text to render and mail. Provide exactly one of pdf, letter, or form. Optional format may be text, html, markdown, or rtf; default is text. Optional signature may be a typed string or drawn signature payload.

form.description: Workflow form payload from postalform.get_form_schema. Provide exactly one of pdf, letter, or form.

bulk.description: Bulk letter campaign: exactly one of csv_content or recipients (JSON list), plus shared PDF or text/HTML template. Omit single-recipient fields, letter, form, and postcard options. color and double_sided apply to every mailpiece.

csv_content.description: Recipient CSV text, mutually exclusive with recipients. Required columns: line1, city, state, zip. Optional: recipient_name, line2, country. Other columns can be used as merge fields.

recipients.description: JSON recipient list, mutually exclusive with csv_content. Each address can include merge_fields for text/HTML templates.

state.description: Required for US and Canadian recipients. Omit or send null elsewhere.

zip.description: ZIP/postal code as a string, preserving leading zeros.

country.description: Mailing country code. Defaults to US.

merge_fields.description: Optional template values. {{field_name}} inserts a value as plain text (HTML-escaped in html mode); in html mode, {{{field_name}}} inserts it as HTML. Address field names and full_address are reserved.

content_mode.description: pdf sends the same top-level PDF to every recipient; text/html render template_text/template_html with CSV columns or JSON merge_fields.

template_text.description: Plain-text letter template. {{field}} inserts a merge value; HTML is not allowed.

template_html.description: HTML letter template. {{field}} inserts a merge value as escaped text; {{{field}}} inserts it as HTML (use this for per-recipient HTML bodies). Scripts and remote resources are not loaded; embed images as data: URLs.

recipient_name.description: Required for a single recipient. Omit when bulk supplies the recipient list.

payment_authorization.description: MPP retry value after paying with Link CLI/Link MCP. Pass the full Authorization header value, usually "Payment ...".

payment_signature.description: x402 retry value after paying the PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge.

tools.name: postalform.pay_order
tools.description: Get an MPP challenge or pay an existing MPP PDF, letter, workflow-form order, or bulk letter campaign after buyer approval. Use the order_id returned by any draft tool with payment_protocol=mpp or by create_machine_order. When switching from create_machine_order, omit the credential first to get this payment endpoint’s challenge. Review the preview or campaign_url, recipient count and total. No document or addresses are resubmitted. Without payment_authorization this only returns a challenge; with it, this can pay and send real mail. Reuse the same order_id on retries and follow the returned payment status.

payment_authorization.description: Buyer-approved MPP Authorization header, usually Payment ... . Omit to retrieve the challenge.

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: After the buyer approves the prepared order and total, pay its existing checkout session using a compatible Stripe payment token, including a shared payment token (spt_...). Pass the order ID as checkout_session_id; do not resend the document or addresses. On an interrupted request, retry the same checkout and token. Existing authorized, processing, or paid payments are reused; follow the returned status and messages.

checkout_session_id.description: The checkout session id to finalize.

buyer.description: Buyer identity details for the approved checkout.

payment_data.description: Buyer-authorized payment token details. Use provider=stripe.

tools.name: postalform.get_order_status
tools.description: Read payment status and total, processing, stored mailing/carrier status, the latest 50 public tracking events, and electronic return receipt availability. Use payment_status_label and payment_status_description: payment_authorized means authorized awaiting capture, even when is_paid=false and paid_at=null. Do not request another payment for authorized, processing or received payments. Bulk orders also return campaign_url, recipient count and per-status counts; use the campaign dashboard for individual recipients. Missing carrier evidence is null; processing or a tracking number alone does not prove mailing or delivery. This read does not pay, mail, or acquire receipts.

tools.name: postalform.ping
tools.description: Use this when you want a quick health check that the PostalForm MCP server is reachable.
